finding.headline: "The Mattress Safety Panic"
finding.problem: "Auntie gave me her old cot. It's beautiful but the mattress is stained and smells. I read old mattresses raise SIDS risk. I can't afford a new one but I'm scared to use this."
finding.person: Budget-conscious Nigerian/diaspora mum offered a free secondhand cot from a neighbour; worried it's unsafe but can't afford new.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (safe-secondhand checklist) / Bonus tool.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
